articles.title: Crypto IPO market stalls as capital rotates to AI and macro uncertainty weighs
articles.snippet: Funding constraints and investor caution, not regulation, are delaying crypto IPOs, according to Cohen & Company Capital Markets' Christian Lopez.

articles.title: The UK has finally shown it’s serious about crypto
articles.snippet: Several recent regulatory steps indicate the UK might finally stop dragging its feet when it comes to crypto, argues Wirex CEO Chet Shah.

articles.title: Hyundai becomes first major South Korean company to introduce internal stablecoin transfers
articles.snippet: The initiative builds on a broader shift by companies exploring stablecoins to move money between international operations more efficiently.

articles.title: OKX, MetaMask, Matter Labs back dispute resolution court for AI agents
articles.snippet: The Genlayer Foundation is leading the 27-firm consortium that makes AI-based payments, escrow and dispute resolution interoperable.

articles.title: Crypto defies equity weakness as altcoin optimism builds into the weekend
articles.snippet: The price of bitcoin hit $64,400, retesting a level it failed to penetrate on Monday, with a break higher opening the path toward the June 15 peak of $67,250.
